headline: Peru Congress Approves 2027 Fiscal Budget Totaling 266.5 Billion Soles
summary: The bicameral Congress of Peru approved the Public Sector Budget for the 2027 fiscal year, totaling 266,506 million soles, prioritizing transparency and sound management.
why: National budget approvals dictate public sector spending limits, infrastructure allocations, and fiscal deficit trajectories for emerging economies.

impacts.why: The national budget sets spending priorities and influences sovereign credit standing.
